findings.evidence: Line 98 explicitly requires `[Finite κ]`, line 125 supplies it to the four multihomogeneous results, and GeneralizedRothLemma.lean requires it in both height lemmas. Every exponent has finite support; multihomogeneity determines n(h,0) from e h and n(h,1) independently of finiteness of κ. Mathlib/Algebra/MvPolynomial/Eval.lean:684 provides `aeval_monomial` without a finite variable-type assumption.
findings.fix: Remove `[Finite κ]` from these statements; compute monomial evaluation over finite supports and prove coefficient correspondence by injectivity of affine exponents on the multihomogeneous support.
findings.issue: Unnecessary `[Finite κ]` prevents using `blockDehomogenize_monomial` with infinitely many available blocks. The same restriction propagates to both coefficient correspondence lemmas, `blockDehomogenize_eq_zero`, `degreeOf_blockDehomogenize_le`, and the two height preservation lemmas in GeneralizedRothLemma.lean.

summary: The dehomogenization API unnecessarily restricts the block index type to be finite.
